execute.sql: DROP TABLE "public"."systemHealth"

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "missionId" text,
  "sosEventId" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_type_check_7cad376a" CHECK ("type" IN ('DIRECT', 'MISSION', 'SOS_GROUP'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversationParticipant" (
  "conversationId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."disaster" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endTime" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "disaster_severity_check_5e5a5e80" CHECK ("severity" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "disaster_status_check_1474f751" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')),
  CONSTRAINT "disaster_type_check_487a6659" CHECK ("type" IN ('STORM', 'FLOOD', 'EARTHQUAKE', 'LANDSLIDE', 'TSUNAMI', 'DROUGHT', 'WILDFIRE', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."disasterArea" (
  "area" geometry(Geometry,4326) NOT NULL,
  "disasterId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "population" int4,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "disasterArea_severity_check_5e5a5e80" CHECK ("severity" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."location" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "point" geometry(Geometry,4326) NOT NULL,
  "timestamp" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "type" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "conversationId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mediaUrl" text,
  "point" geometry(Geometry,4326),
  "readAt" timestamptz,
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  "sentAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "text" text,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'TEXT' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "message_type_check_4f6552e3" CHECK ("type" IN ('TEXT', 'LOCATION', 'IMAGE', 'SYSTEM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "recipientId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_type_check_deef6564" CHECK ("type" IN ('WARNING', 'SOS', 'MISSION_UPDATE', 'SYSTEM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rescueMission" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "requestId" text NOT NULL,
  "rescuerId" text,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ASSIGNED' NOT NULL,
  "teamId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rescueMission_status_check_892ef73b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ASSIGNED', 'IN_ROUTE', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rescueProfile" (
  "availability" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identification" text,
  "skills" text[] NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "vehicle" text,
  "verificationStatus" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rescueProfile_skills_elem_not_null_79c19a4f" CHECK (array_position("skills", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "rescueProfile_verificationStatus_check_5d9c5935" CHECK ("verificationStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rescueRequest" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" geometry(Geometry,4326) NOT NULL,
  "peopleCount" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "requesterId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "urgency" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rescueRequest_status_check_7c3ed2a8" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "rescueRequest_urgency_check_a1ef6707" CHECK ("urgency" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rescueTeam" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "leaderId" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rescueTeam_status_check_b8ad1bc9" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'ON_MISSION'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sOSEvent" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "emergencyType" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" geometry(Geometry,4326) NOT NULL,
  "message" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sOSEvent_status_check_7faa7610" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'RESOLVED', 'FALSE_ALARM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."teamMember" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MEMBER' NOT NULL,
  "teamId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "teamMember_role_check_bcc5eb78" CHECK ("role" IN ('LEADER', 'COORDINATOR', 'SPECIALIST', 'MEMBER', 'VOLUNTEER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "avatar" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'USER' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_168b6c6a" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MODERATOR', 'USER', 'RESCUER')),
  CONSTRAINT "user_status_check_8fe65f21" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'BANNED', 'PENDING'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."warning" (
  "disasterId" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issuedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "warning_severity_check_5e5a5e80" CHECK ("severity" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'))
)
